title: YaRN RoPE Frequency Scaling
prompt: Implement YaRN-style frequency blending with supplied correction-band indices: retain high-frequency pairs, interpolate to frequencies divided by factor, and return the attention magnitude scale 1+0.1*log(factor). Band endpoints are caller-provided.
